prompt: Marketing is checking which promotions overlapped the January sales period, from 10 January 2025 to 10 February 2025. A promotion overlaps that period when its start_date is on or before 10 February 2025 and its end_date is on or after 10 January 2025. A promotion with no end_date recorded (NULL) has not ended, so it overlaps when its start_date is on or before 10 February 2025. A promotion with a missing start_date does not count. For each overlapping promotion, return three columns, in this order: promo_code, promo_name, saving_eur, where saving_eur is the euros a customer saves on a 120-euro item at the promotion's discount_pct (a percentage such as 25 for 25% off). A promotion with no discount_pct recorded gave no discount, so its saving_eur is 0. A promotion with no promo_name still counts. Do not round. Return one row per promotion. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the row filter. Keep a promotion that started by 10 February 2025 and had not ended before 10 January 2025, counting a missing end_date as not ended.

The start-date test joins with AND to a bracketed choice about end_date, which needs its own NULL test. In the saving, replace a missing discount with 0 before the arithmetic, or the result stays NULL.
why_this_works: The bracketed end_date test keeps the open-ended promotion, and replacing a missing discount with 0 makes its saving 0 instead of NULL.
